purpose: The investors band: a centered section title over a two-column bento grid where each cell is an investor's mark, linked to its site, that lifts on hover to reveal a "visit website" line. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'investor-marks', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box` and `bento-grid`.
useWhen: On the company page, to name the investors with their marks.
related: bento-grid` — the grid the marks are laid in.
bestPractices: Give each item a `logoLight` when its mark needs a different file on the light theme; otherwise one `logo` serves both.
Keep `linkLabel` short; it is revealed under the mark on hover and read before the investor name.
